invoices_issued_has_number_ck.name: invoices_issued_has_number_ck
invoices_issued_has_number_ck.value: "invoices"."status" in ('draft','to_issue','cancelled_draft') or ("invoices"."seq_no" is not null and "invoices"."number" is not null)

invoices_supply_ck.name: invoices_supply_ck
invoices_supply_ck.value: "invoices"."doc_type" = 'AV' or "invoices"."status" in ('draft','cancelled_draft') or "invoices"."supply_date" is not null

partner_notes_followup_ix.name: partner_notes_followup_ix
partner_notes_followup_ix.where: "partner_notes"."follow_up_at" is not null and "partner_notes"."follow_up_done_at" is null

users_provider_ck.name: users_provider_ck
users_provider_ck.value:
("users"."provider" = 'entra' and "users"."password_hash" is null and "users"."totp_secret_enc" is null)
                              or ("users"."provider" = 'local' and "users"."entra_oid" is null)
